name: PairDrop
description: Send files and text between your devices in the browser, like AirDrop

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: PairDrop web app, published on host as 6814

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: WS_FALLBACK
variables.description: true sends files through your MOS when two devices cannot connect to each other directly. Set to false to only allow direct transfers.
